question.worked_solution:
First, we remove the parentheses by distributing the negative sign. This gives

$$
3w-w+2
$$

Finally, we collect like terms:

$$
\begin{aligned}3w-w+2 & = \\ (3w-w)+2 & = \\ 2w+2 & \end{aligned}
$$
